answer: A convincing sybil defense is peer-prediction grading: at each summit of the agent economy, every agent grades others' work, and graders are paid by how well their scores correlate with the beacon panel of spot-checked references, not by volume. Fake identities must each grade accurately and stake reputation to earn payout, so a botnet of lazy clones burning compute without correlated judgments loses stake faster than honest agents profit, making forged identity unprofitable like guarding a relic nobody trusts.
